levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد الكوفي

notes: «كنت عند أبي عبد الله ... فدخل عليه رجل ... فقال له» is a narrated encounter: the narrator is present and the Imam speaks, so the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 5). The asker is only in the scene.
«قراءة» (reading) is a gloss on the transmission, not a name.
